subject: How to use warpRefMesh if Digitised Landmarks outside of R

messages.author: 3b002dc67139fd09
messages.subject: How to use warpRefMesh if Digitised Landmarks outside of R
parts:
Hello all, 

I'm using Geomorph for my visualisation and graphics, having using MorphoJ to do initial exploratory analysis and Landmark to create my .dta files on three dimensional models of sheep astragali. I've managed to successfully create a PCA plot in Geomorph and R Studio by importing my Procrustes coordinates as a .txt file which was exported from MorphoJ. I'd really like to utilise the three dimensional morph feature (warpRefMesh) and have found my mean specimen and have a .ply file to hand. The issue is how do I import the relevant mesh.coord and proceed from there? I don't really want to have to landmark my .ply files again, even with the semi-automated features. Any advice? 

Also, I've had a look through the Geomorph guide and want to replicate a CVA and do a warpRefMesh with the canonical variation (I've done this MorphoJ with some workarounds which aren't quite up to publication standard) but can't seem to find that function in this package- is it under a different name? 

Thanks, 

Ashleigh

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] How to use warpRefMesh if Digitised Landmarks outside of R
parts:
Ashleigh,

I’ll let somebody who has experience going between MorphoJ and gomorph answer the first part.  Regarding CVA, I think there is a function in the Mopho package called SVA, and there is the lds function in the MASS package.  We do not offer a specific function for this in geomorph.

Cheers!
Mike

messages.author: 91722721526eb1d7
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] How to use warpRefMesh if Digitised Landmarks outside of R
parts:
Ashleigh,

To use warpRefMesh, I have described this workflow in detail in my geomorph user guide in section 14.10.4.1. 

You need to import the coordinates digitised on that mesh, and have them in a p x k matrix (rows are landmarks, columns are the x, y, z). Likely keep as default centered = FALSE.

Emma

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] How to use warpRefMesh if Digitised Landmarks outside of R

They should be the original coordinates digitized on the mesh, else they wont match up. It doesn't matter how you import them, aslong as they are in p x k matrix format.

Emma
